pkgmetadata.longdescription: Gymnasium is a standard API for single-agent reinforcement learning, with a diverse and growing collection of reference environments that showcase the various capabilities of the API. It is maintained by the Farama Foundation and is the successor to OpenAI Gym.

use.flag: Enable classic control environments (CartPole, Pendulum, MountainCar, etc.) requiring pygame-ce
Enable simple text-based environments (FrozenLake, Taxi, etc.) requiring pygame-ce for rendering
